label: 1-2 steps after an input o, mid/late original phase (t=4-7)
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase on the one or two steps right after the letter o was input, and only late in the input (t=4-7, peak t=5). 99% of activation mass is in the original phase. It never fires in the copy phase and is nearly silent at the delimiter. It never fires at t<3. Strongest when prev_tok is o (68% of mass, 16x lift), weaker when o was two steps back (8.8x lift). The top activations come right after o at original index 3-4, often after a doubled o o. The same o followed at t=3 or t=8 gives little or no activation. There is also a weak, diffuse background of low activations at t=5-6 with no o, coming after other tokens (the digit 3 and c/m give slight lift); the predicate misses these. Dev: precision 0.72, recall 0.55, mass recall 0.82.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=3 & prev_tok=o (+6.35), prev_tok=o (+6.10), prev2_tok=o (+5.88), t=4 & prev_tok=o (+5.74), t=5 & prev_tok=o (+3.61), t=6 (+3.11). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-8.12), prev3_tok=- (-7.03), prev_tok=s (-6.76), prev_tok=y (-5.41).
